objective: Al terminar demuestras que describes personalidades, usas present perfect continuo, used to y past perfect, y cuentas una historia con orden.

warmup.prompt_es: Checkpoint de la unidad 1: personalidad, present perfect simple y continuo, used to / would, past perfect y tiempos narrativos.

input.recap_es: Repasa: adjetivos de personalidad y prefijos negativos, have been + -ing vs have + participio, used to y would, had + participio y la estructura de una historia.

md_es: - *outgoing · reliable · stubborn · bossy · impatient · dishonest · He tends to … · the kind of person who …*
- *I've been working here since 2020* (actividad) · *I've written five reports* (resultado)
- *I used to be shy · We would play outside · Did you use to …? · I didn't use to …*
- *The train had already left when I arrived* (antes) · *By the time … had …*
- *It was raining (escenario) · I opened the door (acción) · I had forgotten my keys (antes)*

exercises.prompt: Une cada adjetivo con su categoría.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Aprende el tono de cada adjetivo.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Aprende el tono de cada adjetivo.

exercises.prompt: The opposite of 'honest' is…

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Since + año.

exercises.prompt: Escribe un párrafo de 8 a 10 frases sobre ti: cómo eres (personalidad), cómo eras de niño (used to), qué has estado haciendo últimamente y una anécdota en el pasado (con past perfect).
exercises.model_answer: I'd describe myself as quite outgoing and reliable, but I can be a bit stubborn. When I was a child I used to be very shy and I would spend hours reading. Lately I've been learning English and I've finished two courses. Last year, by the time I arrived at the airport, the plane had already left, so I had to wait six hours.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
